name: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends
summary: A librarian seeks magical works to expand the library’s collection. You can bring writings that may benefit its shelves.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: Every new book is welcome on these shelves. Magical writings may add to what the library knows, and your discoveries can help its knowledge grow.

faq.answer: The librarian seeks magical works that might benefit the collection.

faq.q: Where should I bring the books?
faq.answer: Bring the magical works to the librarian Garion Wendell in Stormwind, or to Owen Thadd in Undercity if you are Horde.
The librarian says the collection expands the library’s knowledge.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends
